theorem nonzero_square_mod_three_iff (n : ℤ) : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3] := by
  have h₁ : ∀ (n : ℤ), (¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n) ↔ (n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2) := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₂ : n % 3 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h₃
        apply h
        omega
      have h₃ : n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
        omega
      exact h₃
    · 
      intro h
      have h₂ : n % 3 ≠ 0 := by
        rcases h with (h | h) <;> omega
      have h₃ : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n := by
        intro h₄
        have h₅ : (3 : ℤ) ∣ n := h₄
        have h₆ : (n % 3 = 0) := by
          omega
        omega
      exact h₃
  
  have h₂ : ∀ (n : ℤ), (n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3]) ↔ (n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2) := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₃ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := by
        simpa [Int.ModEq] using h
      have h₄ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₄ with (h₄ | h₄ | h₄)
      ·

          have h₅₂ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 0 := by
            norm_num [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, h₅₁]
          exact h₅₂
        omega
      · 
        exact Or.inl h₄
      · 
        have h₅ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := by
          have h₅₁ : (n : ℤ) % 3 = 2 := h₄
          have h₅₂ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := by
            norm_num [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, h₅₁]
          exact h₅₂
        omega
    · 
      intro h
      rcases h with (h | h)
      · 
        have h₃ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := by
          have h₄ : (n : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := h
          norm_num [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, h₄]
        simpa [Int.ModEq] using h₃
      · 
        have h₃ : (n ^ 2 : ℤ) % 3 = 1 := by
          have h₄ : (n : ℤ) % 3 = 2 := h
          norm_num [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, h₄]
        simpa [Int.ModEq] using h₃
  
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₃ : n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      rw [h₁] at h
      exact h
    have h₄ : (n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3]) := by
      rw [h₂]
      tauto
    exact h₄

    have h₄ : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n := by
      intro h₅

      have h₇ : n % 3 = 0 := by
        omega
      rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃)
      · 
        omega
      · 
        omega
    exact h₄
